@@ -7,6 +7,9 @@ rust-version.workspace = true
 
 [build-dependencies]
 chrono = "0.4"
+# #1461: embeds the logotype .ico in the Windows exe (a missing resource compiler only warns).
+[target.'cfg(windows)'.build-dependencies]
+winresource = { version = "0.1", default-features = false }
 
 [dependencies]
 camcraft-app = { workspace = true }

@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+# 1461 - logotype in the packaging
+
+Format: see `docs/decisions/README.md`.
+
+- **Exe icon via `winresource` (new build dependency, needs the maintainer's yes).** Chosen: `winresource` (default features off) as a `cfg(windows)` build-dependency of `camcraft-ui`, called from the existing `crates/ui/build.rs`. Embedding a Windows exe icon needs a resource-compiler step; a hand-written `.rc` still needs `rc.exe`/`windres` and a `build.rs` call, so a small wrapper is the least code. A missing resource compiler only prints a `cargo:warning` and the build goes on (an exe without an icon is cosmetic, never a failed dev build). Dropped: a hand-rolled COFF resource writer (more code, more ways to be wrong).
+- **macOS `.icns` from the generated sizes.** Each iconset entry uses the matching `camcraft-<size>.png`; only the 1024 px (512@2x) entry is scaled up from the 512 px one, since no 1024 px size is generated.
+- **Linux: 256 px for the pixmap, flatpak, snap and AppImage; the `.deb`/rpm also install the hicolor 16-512 sizes.** Dropped: ImageMagick `convert` in the AppImage script (the 256 px file is already generated).
+- **Wasm shell favicon left as is.** `site/static/favicon.png` serves the docs site, not the `/app/` shell, and replacing it is a site change; not part of this PR.

@@ -63,7 +63,12 @@ exec /usr/lib/camcraft/$binary "\$@"
 EOF
     chmod 755 "$pkg_root/usr/bin/$command_name"
 done
-install -m 644 assets/ui/cube.png "$pkg_root/usr/share/pixmaps/camcraft.png"
+install -m 644 assets/logo/icons/camcraft-256.png "$pkg_root/usr/share/pixmaps/camcraft.png"

+    install -m 644 "assets/logo/icons/camcraft-$size.png" \

+done

@@ -49,13 +49,21 @@ done
 install -m 644 RELEASE_NOTES.md TESTING.md LICENSE NOTICE README.md "$resources/"
 iconset="$work/CamCraft.iconset"
 mkdir -p "$iconset"
+# The logotype's generated sizes (cargo xtask logo, #1459); only 1024 px (512@2x) is scaled up from the 512 px one.
+logo_icon() {
+    if [ -f "assets/logo/icons/camcraft-$1.png" ]; then
+        echo "assets/logo/icons/camcraft-$1.png"
+    else
+        echo "assets/logo/icons/camcraft-512.png"
+    fi
+}
 for size in 16 32 128 256 512; do
-    sips -s format png -z "$size" "$size" assets/ui/cube.png \
+    sips -s format png -z "$size" "$size" "$(logo_icon "$size")" \
         --out "$iconset/icon_${size}x${size}.png" >/dev/null
 done
 for size in 16 32 128 256 512; do
     double=$((size * 2))
-    sips -s format png -z "$double" "$double" assets/ui/cube.png \
+    sips -s format png -z "$double" "$double" "$(logo_icon "$double")" \
         --out "$iconset/icon_${size}x${size}@2x.png" >/dev/null
 done
 iconutil -c icns "$iconset" -o "$resources/CamCraft.icns"
